memories.author: D05
memories.text: Diagnosis: Polycystic ovary syndrome. The patient presents with irregular menstrual cycles, mild hirsutism, and weight gain over the past year. She reports no dyspnea or wheeze; respiratory examination is clear. Smoking status: never. Spirometry not indicated for pulmonary disease; FEV1, FVC, and ratio are within normal limits (not recorded). She is not using inhalers; technique assessment not applicable. Plan: start metformin 500 mg twice daily and combined oral contraceptive pill daily; lifestyle modification advised.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Metformin 500 mg tablets, take one tablet twice daily with meals. Combined oral contraceptive pill (ethinylestradiol 30 mcg/levonorgestrel 150 mcg), take one tablet daily at same time each day. Continue for 3 months, then review.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum testosterone 68 ng/dL (reference 15-70). LH 8 IU/L (reference 2-12). FSH 6 IU/L (reference 2-12). LH:FSH ratio 1.33. HbA1c 5.6% (reference 4-5.6).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have noticed my periods are still irregular and I have gained about 3 kg since the last visit. My facial acne has worsened a little. I am taking the metformin and pill as prescribed.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:00 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05). Please arrive 10 minutes early.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Diagnosis: Polycystic ovary syndrome, stable. Menstrual cycles have become more regular (approx every 35 days). Mild hirsutism unchanged, weight stable. No respiratory complaints; exam clear. Smoking status: never. Spirometry within normal limits (FEV1 2.9 L, 92% predicted; FVC 3.2 L, 95%; FEV1/FVC 0.91). Not using inhalers; technique not applicable. Plan: continue current metformin and COCP; reinforce diet and exercise.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Metformin 500 mg tablets, take one tablet twice daily with meals. Combined oral contraceptive pill (ethinylestradiol 30 mcg/levonorgestrel 150 mcg), take one tablet daily at same time each day. Continue for 3 months, then review.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 5.5% (reference 4-5.6). Serum testosterone 62 ng/dL (reference 15-70). LH 7.5 IU/L (reference 2-12). FSH 5.8 IU/L (reference 2-12). LH:FSH ratio 1.29.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Pelvic ultrasound: Bilateral ovaries show multiple small follicles (>=10 per ovary) with increased stromal echogenicity; uterine lining normal thickness. No dominant cyst seen. Findings consistent with polycystic ovarian morphology.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Dr Priya Nair, Gynecology, for further management of PCOS and assessment of fertility concerns. Please evaluate menstrual regulation and discuss ovulation induction options.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Gynecology review: Patient advised to continue metformin and COCP. No immediate fertility treatment required. Lifestyle reinforcement advised. Follow-up in 6 months or sooner if symptoms change.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: My periods are now coming every 28-30 days and I have less acne. I feel more energetic. I have been walking 30 minutes daily and have lost about 1.5 kg.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Diagnosis: Polycystic ovary syndrome, well-controlled. Menstrual cycles regular (28-30 days). Mild hirsutism stable, weight down 2 kg from baseline. No respiratory symptoms; exam clear. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 3.0 L (95% predicted), FVC 3.3 L (98%), FEV1/FVC 0.91 (change +0.1 L since last). Not using inhalers; technique not applicable. Plan: increase metformin to 850 mg twice daily to further improve insulin sensitivity; continue COCP.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Metformin 850 mg tablets, take one tablet twice daily with meals. Combined oral contraceptive pill (ethinylestradiol 30 mcg/levonorgestrel 150 mcg), take one tablet daily at same time each day. Continue for 3 months, then review.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 5.4% (reference 4-5.6). Serum testosterone 58 ng/dL (reference 15-70). LH 7.0 IU/L (reference 2-12). FSH 5.5 IU/L (reference 2-12). LH:FSH ratio 1.27.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed: moved from 2026-07-10 to 2026-06-15 at 09:30 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05). Please confirm attendance.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Diagnosis: Polycystic ovary syndrome, controlled. Menstrual cycles regular (28-32 days). Mild hirsutism unchanged, weight stable after initial loss. No respiratory complaints; exam clear. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 3.0 L (95% predicted), FVC 3.3 L (98%), FEV1/FVC 0.91 (no significant change). Not using inhalers; technique not applicable. Plan: maintain metformin 850 mg BD and COCP OD; annual review advised.
